headline: Ranabaali is now streaming on Netflix: OTT release date and where to watch
dek: The Telugu film, starring Vijay Deverakonda, Rashmika Mandanna, Arnold Vosloo, arrived on Netflix 4 weeks after opening in cinemas on 16 October.
paragraphs: Ranabaali is streaming on Netflix in India from 13 November.
That is 28 days after its theatrical release on 16 October — in line with the typical 28 days for Telugu films, based on 12 recent releases tracked by New on OTT.
Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.
Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, starring Vijay Deverakonda, Rashmika Mandanna, Arnold Vosloo, Easwari Rao, Vinod Sagar. The film runs 179 minutes and is certified U/A 16+.
New on OTT re-checks Netflix's India listing every day; the page for Ranabaali has the latest on where to watch it.
title: Ranabaali
